name.fr-FR: Sermons du vénérable serviteur de Dieu J.-B.-M. Vianney, curé d’Ars
name.en-US: Sermons of the Curé of Ars

author.en-US: St. John Vianney, the Curé of Ars
author.pt-BR: São João Maria Vianney, o Cura d’Ars

description.fr-FR: Soixante-dix-sept prônes du Curé d’Ars pour les dimanches et les fêtes de l’année, de l’Avent à la Toussaint, écrits de sa main entre 1818 et 1827 et publiés en quatre tomes en 1883, avec la préface et les notes des éditeurs.
description.en-US: Seventy-seven parish sermons of the Curé of Ars for the Sundays and feasts of the year, from Advent to All Saints, written in his own hand between 1818 and 1827 and published in four volumes in 1883, with the editors’ preface and notes.
description.pt-BR: Setenta e sete prédicas do Cura d’Ars para os domingos e festas do ano, do Advento a Todos os Santos, escritas de próprio punho entre 1818 e 1827 e publicadas em quatro tomos em 1883, com o prefácio e as notas dos editores.

sources.edition: Sermons du vénérable serviteur de Dieu J.-B.-M. Vianney, curé d’Ars, 4 tomes, Paris, Victor Lecoffre / Lyon, Ruban, 1883 (OCR of the Bibliothèque Saint Libère scan, liberius.net)
sources.description: Approbation of Cardinal Caverot (20 Aug 1882), the editors’ preface, the sermons and the end notes. Running heads, page footers and the tables of contents are removed; page-bottom notes are footnotes. Per the 1883 preface, several sermons are adaptations of earlier preachers (Lejeune and others).
